scope: Keep retained mission boards, NPC jobs, expansion quests, and authored mission difficulty bands while preventing the removed NGE player combat level from regaining authority through residual or reactivated dynamic-mission helpers.

findings: Publish 14.1 characters progress through learned skill boxes and a 250-point skill budget rather than an NGE profession template or visible combat level.
The current mission board already derives its hidden 1-90 compatibility score from the loaded party's PRE-CU combat skill boxes and applies the authenticated full-credit group reward rule.
All six retained Mos Eisley NPC mission conversations already use the established PRE-CU encounter-difficulty adapter.
Two dormant planet-hunting helpers retained raw NGE player-level reads, and the escort NPC request path performed a third raw read whose value was never consumed.
Routing the two compatibility checks through the skill-box adapter and deleting the unused escort read preserves authored mission content while closing current and future NGE level precedence.
